RESULTADO (análisis ejecutado; script y tablas en artifacts)

## 1) Tabla grupo × año (casos completos por celda; N y faltante junto a cada mediana)
Grupo "white_proxy" = código 3 de `Racial/ethnic cohort, 1979` = NON-BLACK NON-HISPANIC, usado como **proxy** de "white" (no es una medida estricta de blancos no hispanos).

| Año | Grupo | N cohorte | N obs | Faltante | Mediana (USD corrientes) | IC95 | Mediana USD 1996 | Media (solo ref.) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1985 | white_proxy | 7510 | 5774 | 23,1% | 3.500 | [3.200; 3.700] | 5.104 | 15.201 |
| 1985 | black | 2002 | 1699 | 15,1% | 1.600 | [1.480; 1.800] | 2.333 | 7.728 |
| 1985 | hispanic | 3174 | 2631 | 17,1% | 500 | [400; 600] | 729 | 4.919 |
| 1990 | white_proxy | 7510 | 5336 | 28,9% | 12.972 | [11.849; 13.700] | 15.572 | 52.387 |
| 1990 | black | 2002 | 1528 | 23,7% | 4.800 | [4.000; 5.410] | 5.762 | 27.220 |
| 1990 | hispanic | 3174 | 2431 | 23,4% | 1.600 | [1.400; 2.000] | 1.921 | 13.394 |
| 1996 | white_proxy | 7510 | 3557 | **52,6%** | 42.600 | [40.500; 45.700] | 42.600 | 114.352 |
| 1996 | black | 2002 | 1368 | 31,7% | 9.800 | [8.250; 11.694] | 9.800 | 45.080 |
| 1996 | hispanic | 3174 | 2114 | 33,4% | 2.562 | [2.000; 3.000] | 2.562 | 22.213 |

## 2) Contrastes dentro del año (razón = métrica principal, insensible al CPI) + diferencia absoluta
| Año | Contraste | Razón | IC95 (bootstrap por celda) | IC95 (bootstrap por respondiente) | Diferencia USD | IC95 | Diferencia USD 1996 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1985 | white_proxy vs black | 2,19x | [1,84; 2,50] | [1,83; 2,47] | 1.900 | [1.500; 2.200] | 2.771 |
| 1985 | white_proxy vs hispanic | 7,00x | [5,79; 8,75] | [5,74; 8,75] | 3.000 | [2.700; 3.200] | 4.375 |
| 1990 | white_proxy vs black | 2,70x | [2,31; 3,27] | [2,31; 3,30] | 8.172 | [6.875; 9.325] | 9.810 |
| 1990 | white_proxy vs hispanic | 8,11x | [6,38; 9,20] | [6,33; 9,16] | 11.372 | [10.120; 12.120] | 13.652 |
| 1996 | white_proxy vs black | **4,35x** | [3,70; 5,30] | [3,67; 5,22] | 32.800 | [30.300; 36.202] | 32.800 |
| 1996 | white_proxy vs hispanic | **16,62x** | [13,77; 21,25] | [13,78; 21,50] | 40.038 | [37.900; 43.202] | 40.038 |

**Núcleo de la comparación — la brecha se AMPLÍA en términos relativos y absolutos:**
- white_proxy/black: 2,19x → 2,70x → 4,35x; ratio-of-ratios 1996/1985 = **1,99 (IC95 1,67–2,49)**; se amplía en el 100% de las 2.000 réplicas del bootstrap por respondiente.
- white_proxy/hispanic: 7,00x → 8,11x → 16,62x; ratio-of-ratios 1996/1985 = **2,37 (IC95 1,89–3,15)**; se amplía en el 100% de las réplicas.
- No es "razón constante con medianas crecientes": las medianas suben en los tres grupos y la razón también sube → brecha relativa Y absoluta creciente. Diferencia mediana (white_proxy − black): 1.900 → 8.172 → 32.800 USD; (white_proxy − hispanic): 3.000 → 11.372 → 40.038 USD.
- Orden estable: white_proxy > black > hispanic en los tres cortes; la brecha con hispanos es la mayor en cada año.

## 3) Robustez (breve; la mediana sigue siendo el estimador principal)
| Especificación | Año | white_proxy | black | hispanic | raz. w/b | raz. w/h |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Excl. hogar parental (resid. 17/18/19) | 1985 | 4.650 | 2.502 | 1.000 | 1,86x | 4,65x |
| | 1990 | 14.200 | 5.800 | 2.100 | 2,45x | 6,76x |
| | 1996 | 46.000 | 11.818 | 3.500 | 3,89x | 13,14x |
| Panel balanceado (5.739 IDs en las 3 olas) | 1985 | 3.800 | 1.600 | 300 | 2,38x | 12,67x |
| | 1990 | 14.750 | 4.100 | 1.200 | 3,60x | 12,29x |
| | 1996 | 42.600 | 9.075 | 2.400 | 4,69x | 17,75x |
| Media recortada p99 (solo nota) | 1985/1990/1996 | 12.645/52.387/114.352 | 6.651/22.392/39.822 | 3.768/9.433/17.841 | 1,90→2,87x | 3,36→6,41x |
| Media aritmética (solo nota) | 1985/1990/1996 | 15.201/52.387/114.352 | 7.728/27.220/45.080 | 4.919/13.394/22.213 | 1,97→2,54x | 3,09→5,15x |

Lectura: el ensanchamiento **no** es un artefacto de la atrición diferencial de 1996 (52,6% de faltantes en la cohorte de referencia frente a 32/33%) ni de la composición: en el panel balanceado se reproduce e incluso se amplifica. Las medias (1,9–2,5x y 3,1–5,2x) son menos desiguales que las medianas, señal de que la brecha mediana no es un efecto de la cola superior (los máximos están topcodificados: 16/84/141 obs en el valor máximo exacto). Descriptivo de apoyo (sin interpretación causal): tenencia de vivienda propia entre quienes reportan riqueza, 1996 = 63,9% white_proxy / 42,5% black / 26,2% hispanic.

## 4) HIPÓTESIS FINAL (inglés, para el envío)
"Among NLSY79 respondents, family net wealth of the non-black non-Hispanic cohort — used here as a PROXY for 'white', because this dataset encodes race/ethnicity only as the 1979 racial/ethnic cohort (1=BLACK, 2=HISPANIC, 3=NON-BLACK NON-HISPANIC) and contains no strict non-Hispanic white identifier — exceeded that of black and Hispanic respondents at the median in every wave in which wealth is observed, and the gap widened between 1985 and 1996. The white-proxy/black median wealth ratio rose from about 2.2x in 1985 (USD 3,500 vs 1,600) to 2.7x in 1990 (12,972 vs 4,800) and 4.3x in 1996 (42,600 vs 9,800), a 1996/1985 ratio-of-ratios of 2.0 (95% CI 1.7-2.5); the white-proxy/Hispanic ratio rose from 7.0x (3,500 vs 500) to 8.1x (12,972 vs 1,600) and 16.6x (42,600 vs 2,562), a ratio-of-ratios of 2.4 (95% CI 1.9-3.1). Because median wealth grew for all three groups, both the relative and the absolute gaps widened: the median difference over the white-proxy group grew from about USD 1,900 (black) and 3,000 (Hispanic) in 1985 to about 32,800 and 40,000 (1996 dollars) in 1996. The rank ordering white-proxy > black > Hispanic was stable in all three waves, and the widening is reproduced in a balanced panel of the 5,739 respondents observed in all waves and when parental-household residents are excluded, so it is not driven by composition or by the 1996 non-response (52.6% missing in the reference cohort vs 31.7%/33.4%). Means and p99-Winsorised means show smaller ratios (roughly 1.9-2.9x vs black, 3.1-6.4x vs Hispanic) than the medians, indicating the median gap is not an artefact of top-coded wealthy tails. This conclusion rests on three unweighted observational waves of family-level (not individual) net wealth with a coarse racial/ethnic proxy and 15-53% item missingness per cell, so it describes an association and its trajectory over 1985-1996, not a causal mechanism, and should not be read as U.S.-population estimates."

## 5) Workflow (constancias)
Derivación de grupos desde `Racial/ethnic cohort, 1979` → reshape a largo (solo 1985/1990/1996; no hay riqueza en otros años) → casos completos por celda (sin imputación) → mediana + IC percentile bootstrap (2.000 réplicas) por celda → razones y diferencias dentro del año (principal) → bootstrap a nivel de respondiente (remuestrea el panel completo de cada persona, respeta correlación intra-individuo entre olas) para la razón de razones 1996/1985 → sensibilidades (exclusión de códigos de residencia 17/18/19, panel balanceado, medias, medias Winsorizadas p99). **El deflactor CPI-U usado para la columna secundaria en dólares de 1996 está hardcodeado (1985=107.6, 1990=130.7, 1996=156.9, medias anuales BLS) y NO proviene de los datos**; las razones dentro del año son invariantes a la inflación y por eso son la métrica principal. El archivo no contiene pesos muestrales, estratos ni PSU, así que las medianas son de la muestra observada (cohorte con sobremuestreo de negros e hispanos y submuestras militares), no estimaciones poblacionales.

payload.workflow: 1) Derived race/ethnicity groups from `Racial/ethnic cohort, 1979` (3=non-black non-Hispanic, proxy for white; 1=black; 2=Hispanic) - no explicit white/black/Hispanic variables exist in the file. 2) Reshaped the three available wealth waves (1985, 1990, 1996; no wealth variables exist for any other year) to long format; complete cases per cell, no imputation of wealth. 3) Primary estimator = median family net wealth per group x year with percentile bootstrap CIs (2,000 replicates, seed 20261025), reporting N and missing rate next to every median. 4) Primary contrasts = within-year ratios (inflation-invariant) plus absolute differences in levels, with cell-wise bootstrap CIs. 5) Respondent-level (cluster) bootstrap resampling each respondent's whole panel (seed 7) to obtain CIs for the cross-year change (ratio-of-ratios 1996/1985) while respecting within-person correlation. 6) Sensitivity analyses (not primary): excluding respondents living in parental households (residence codes 17/18/19), a balanced panel of the 5,739 respondents observed in all three waves, arithmetic means and p99-Winsorised means (tails are top-coded at 1,054,132 / 1,321,099 / 1,232,183). 7) Secondary deflated column converts mediles/differences to 1996 dollars with HARDCODED CPI-U annual-average deflators (1985=107.6, 1990=130.7, 1996=156.9, BLS); the CPI does NOT come from the dataset, which is why within-year ratios are the headline metric. 8) The file contains no survey weights, strata or PSUs, so all estimates are sample-based, not U.S.-population estimates. Executed script: analysis/wealth_gap_analysis.py (also --diagnostics); outputs: outputs/table_group_year_medians.csv, table_contrasts.csv, table_cluster_bootstrap_ratios.csv, table_robustness.csv, SUMMARY.md, main_run_log.txt, extra_diagnostics.txt.
